title: USCIS Exam Guides
description: USCIS Exam Guides explains the USCIS medical exam process, requirements, timelines, and what to prepare before choosing a civil surgeon.
main_html:
Short answer

USCIS Exam Guides is a neutral resource that helps people understand the USCIS medical exam process and how to prepare. USCIS Exam Guides explains requirements, timelines, documentation, and what typically happens during and after the exam. USCIS Exam Guides does not recommend specific civil surgeons. It helps you understand the process so you can move forward confidently.
